hazards.reason: Copying label and order_label holds the database's write lock for time that grows with the tables.
hazards.subject: table/label

hazards.reason: Label.name changes from TEXT COLLATE NOCASE to TEXT: servers built from the previous version still read and write TEXT COLLATE NOCASE.
hazards.subject: table/label/column/name

hazards.reason: SQLite's ALTER TABLE cannot change the type of name, so the step rebuilds label with the tables that reference it, directly or through another table: order_label. It copies the rows of each table it keeps into a new table, drops the old tables and renames the new ones.
hazards.subject: table/label

statements:
CREATE TABLE "_new_label" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "_new_order_label" (
  "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("order_id", "label_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("label_id") REFERENCES "_new_label" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY ("order_id") REFERENCES "order" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
steps.subject: table/label
